says: In our lint tooling, `pnpm -s lint:promise-types` dies with EPIPE inside a full `pnpm lint` in a cloud box, and passes alone with 0 findings. The stack ends in typescript 7.0.2's `SyncRpcChannel.writeAllBuf`, reached from `snapshot.dispose()` on source line 323, the line the stack trace names. This is the box-memory case: the parallel tsgo parts of `pnpm lint` run under the cloud box's memory limit and one loses its RPC pipe. The merge session reported filing a ticket for the box-memory case, and its number was not given to this step, so this row records the sightings only.
proof: Seen 3 times on 2026-11-16: two full `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 pnpm lint` runs on fabrikalfa/mock-app-e2e-s1 at ecf1593af, each with 1 of 18 parts failing (lint:promise-types) and each passing when that part was rerun alone; and once in field/runs/2026-11-16-mock-app-e2e-tests2.json, where lint:promise-types exited 1 with an RPC stack trace in the full run and gave 0 findings alone. A fourth sighting the same day, in the tests step's own second full lint on fabrikalfa/mock-app-e2e-s1 (head 9f286f44c plus that step's uncommitted lint-config and plant edits, with the other code agent's tsgo running): 4 of 18 parts failed, lint:promise-types with the same stack (SyncRpcChannel.writeAllBuf from Snapshot.dispose at promise-types.ts:323:16), lint:kind and lint:dead with EPIPE, and oxlint-plugins/lint.ts with 'oxlint did not finish: status null'; each part passed when rerun alone. The same step's first full lint, run minutes earlier, passed 18 of 18.
cost: A full lint in a cloud box can read as red for no code reason, and each step must rerun the part alone and say so before it can call lint green.
